Name: Group Chat - Immersive NPC Group Conversations
Author: acharles1
Description:
[b]Group Chat[/b]

[b]Talk to one villager. Let the whole group join in.[/b]
Ever walked into a festival and thought, [i]“Alright... time to click 26 people one by one.”[/i]
Yeah.
[b]No more.[/b]
And no generative AI, LLMs or generated dialogue. Just the villagers being themselves.

With [b]Group Chat[/b], talking to one villager can naturally pull nearby villagers into the conversation, one after another.
So instead of:
click Abigail
walk two steps
click Sebastian
click Sam
squeeze past Pierre
click Caroline
accidentally click a chair
forget who you already talked to...
you can just:
[b]walk up to the group → talk once → everyone gets their turn[/b]
Much better. 😂

[b]And with V1.1 — Social Circle —[/b] you can now choose whether everyone nearby joins, or only villagers who actually have a believable connection to the person you started talking to.



🌱 [b]HOW IT WORKS[/b]
Talk to any villager like normal.
If other eligible villagers are nearby, Group Chat can gather them into the conversation.
Your farmer turns toward each person as they speak, and every villager uses [b]dialogue that already exists in the game[/b] — including daily, contextual, and festival dialogue provided through Stardew Valley’s normal systems.
Group Chat continues until each participant has said everything they currently have to say that is [b]safe to show[/b]. Questions and personal moments are left for you to handle normally.
Then everyone gets back to their day.
Sometimes with a few little emotes afterward. ❤️


💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Group Chat is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its conversation mechanics use NPC and dialogue information already available through Stardew Valley’s normal gameplay systems.
The mod does not generate, copy, rewrite, or redistribute NPC dialogue, portraits, sprites, code, schedules, character writing, or other NPC content.
Any dialogue displayed by Group Chat remains supplied by the game data that originally provides it. Group Chat simply changes how eligible nearby conversations are presented to the player.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Group Chat, including development of the mod’s code.
Some UI icons were created with AI generation based on original concepts made specifically for Group Chat.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Group Chat does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Group Chat uses Stardew Valley’s existing NPC and dialogue systems. AI does not generate NPC dialogue, character content, responses, conversations, or other gameplay content at runtime. 


👋 [b]NEW IN V1.1.1 — FIRST MEETING GUARD[/b]
Group Chat now protects first introductions too.
If you haven’t met a villager yet, they’ll give their proper introduction dialogue first instead of immediately cycling into familiar everyday dialogue.
Once introduced, Group Chat leaves their normal dialogue alone for the rest of that day.
The next day, they can join Group Chat normally.
This works in both Group and Social Circle modes.
And if you somehow never met an NPC during Stardew’s normal introduction period, Group Chat can still safely use their proper introduction.


🫂 [b]NEW IN V1.1.0 — SOCIAL CIRCLE[/b]
Social Circle makes Group Chat more relationship-aware.
Nearby villagers can join if they’re connected to the original speaker through:
[list]
[*]Family[/*]
[*]Living in the same home[/*]
[*]Meaningful heart/story events you’ve already seen[/*]
[/list]That last part means Social Circle can actually grow as you progress.
As you unlock more heart events and see villagers meaningfully interact with each other, new believable Social Circle connections can become available.
So progressing relationships now has a little extra payoff beyond the event itself. ❤️
(Generic festival attendance doesn’t count, and every villager must connect directly to the original speaker — no friends-of-friends chain-pulling.)


🌻 [b]PERFECT FOR FESTIVALS[/b]
This is where Group Chat really shines.
At the Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Stardew Valley Fair, Spirit’s Eve and other festivals, villagers are already standing around in little social groups.
So now those groups can actually [b]feel like groups[/b].
Walk over to one cluster.
Talk to somebody.
Everyone nearby gets their turn.
No sprinting around Pelican Town’s entire population like you’re doing attendance.
And importantly:
[b]Group Chat only handles conversation.[/b]
It won’t suddenly:
[list]
[*]start the Egg Hunt[/*]
[*]trigger the Flower Dance[/*]
[*]launch a competition[/*]
[*]open a shop[/*]
[*]advance the festival[/*]
[*]make choices for you[/*]
[/list]So you get the convenience [b]without losing control[/b].


🧸 [b]THREE CONVERSATION MODES[/b]
Group Chat has three ways to play:
[b]👥 GROUP[/b]
ALL nearby group conversations.
The classic Group Chat experience.
Nearby eligible villagers can join regardless of their relationship to the person you started with.
[b]🫂 SOCIAL CIRCLE[/b]
Relationship-based conversations.
Only nearby villagers connected to the original speaker through family, home, or meaningful story progression can join.
[b]👤 SINGLE[/b]
One-on-one conversations.
Only the villager you selected speaks.
Cycle between:
[b]Group → Social Circle → Single → Group[/b]
using either the dialogue-side icon or your configured G hotkey.
If you switch modes during an already-running conversation, that conversation stays exactly as it started.
Your new mode applies to the next conversation.
The mod itself can be enabled or disabled through GMCM.
👁️ [b]NEW IN V1.1.1 — AUTO-HIDE DIALOGUE ICON[/b]
Prefer a cleaner dialogue screen?
There’s now an optional Auto-hide Dialogue Icon setting in GMCM.
When enabled:
[list]
[*]The mode icon stays hidden until you hover over its normal position.[/*]
[*]Hovering reveals the icon and tooltip.[/*]
[*]Clicking still cycles modes normally.[/*]
[*]Pressing G temporarily reveals the newly selected mode icon for quick feedback.[/*]
[*]The icon hides again after a moment if you aren’t hovering it.[/*]
[*]Controller / Steam Deck users keep the icon visible so the control stays accessible.[/*]
[/list]The setting is OFF by default, so existing behavior stays unchanged unless you turn it on.


✨ [b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]Talk to one villager and nearby eligible villagers can join[/*]
[*]Three modes: Group / Social Circle / Single[/*]
[*]First Meeting Guard protects NPC introduction dialogue[/*]
[*]Newly introduced NPCs wait until the next day before normal Group Chat dialogue[/*]
[*]Works even if Stardew’s normal introduction period has already passed[/*]
[*]Social Circle recognises family, shared homes, and meaningful heart/story events[/*]
[*]Social connections can grow as you progress through character events[/*]
[*]Every Social Circle participant must connect directly to the original speaker[/*]
[*]No friends-of-friends chain-pulling[/*]
[*]Fully exhausts available safe dialogue so you don't need to run back and click everyone again[/*]
[*]Farmer turns toward whoever is speaking[/*]
[*]Configurable conversation radius from 2–10 tiles[/*]
[*]Protects questions and personal conversations[/*]
[*]Villagers with something personal to ask may show a ❓[/*]
[*]Questions are skipped so you can answer them manually[/*]
[*]Safe around gifts, shops, services, tools, items, spouses, and special interactions[/*]
[*]Festival-safe during normal free-roam conversation[/*]
[*]Small staggered end-of-conversation emotes[/*]
[*]Quick dialogue-side mode control[/*]
[*]Optional Auto-hide Dialogue Icon[/*]
[*]Configurable hotkey for mode cycling[/*]
[*]Lightweight and interaction-driven — no constant world scanning[/*]
[*]Relationship information is cached instead of repeatedly scanned every frame[/*]
[*]Uses NPC relationship and dialogue information already available through Stardew Valley’s normal game systems[/*]
[/list]

❓ [b]PERSONAL CONVERSATIONS[/b]
Sometimes a villager has something they specifically want to ask [b]you[/b].
Group Chat protects those moments.
If a pending personal question is detected, that villager is excluded from the group conversation and may show a small:
[b]❓[/b]
above their head.
Talk to them manually and their conversation proceeds normally.
Group Chat never answers questions or makes personal choices for you.


❤️ [b]LITTLE SOCIAL MOMENTS[/b]
When a successful Group Chat finishes, villagers can react with small staggered emotes afterward.
Nothing dramatic.
Just little:
[b]❤️ ♪ 😊 ! ...[/b]
The farmer may react too.
These little moments are purely cosmetic, but they help the conversation feel like a shared social moment rather than a sequence of menu boxes.


💚 [b]WHY GROUP CHAT?[/b]
Because sometimes the villagers are already standing together.
They already feel like a group.
Now talking to them can feel like one too.



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]
